migrations.rollbackGuidance: Drop only the newly created empty AMESH database; never run this bootstrap against an existing application schema.
Leave retry_at and its partial index in place and forward-fix consumers; removing the column requires a later contract migration.
Keep additive resource metadata columns and forward-fix writers; do not discard actor or lifecycle evidence.
Disable new authorization entry points and forward-fix policy data; never silently remove bindings or audit evidence.
Stop issuing new credentials and forward-fix the schema; retain digests and revocation evidence until policy permits purge.
Restore from the pre-migration backup if tenant ownership backfill fails; do not disable forced RLS as a rollback shortcut.
Forward-fix notification routing; durable queue polling remains authoritative while notifications are unavailable.
Restore the prior role grants only during a controlled rollback; never grant runtime callers table-owner or BYPASSRLS authority.
Revoke use of the administration functions and forward-fix them; preserve tenant audit and export rows.
Keep the additive trigger_context column and forward-fix readers; old readers safely ignore it.
Pause event publication and forward-fix triggers/upcasters; retain immutable event, rejection and outbox evidence.
Stop metadata writers and forward-fix additive tables or constraints; retain logs, metrics, assets and trigger definitions according to retention policy.
Stop transport publishers and consumers and forward-fix additive retry or quarantine fields; retain queued, outbox and dead-letter evidence for operator resolution.
Pause executor dispatch publication and forward-fix the task-run event trigger; retain task-run events and outbox rows as recovery evidence.
Pause schedulers and forward-fix additive cursor or ownership fields; retain schedule state so missed occurrences can be reconciled deterministically.
Drain remote workers and forward-fix additive protocol or heartbeat fields; retain worker and attempt lease evidence until all claims are reconciled.
Pause execution interventions and forward-fix additive deadline or classification fields; retain execution/task events and active attempt evidence.
Pause new subflow launches and forward-fix the additive relationship contract; retain parent and child executions plus immutable task and execution evidence.
Pause new admission requests and forward-fix the additive reservation and quota tables; retain decision evidence until affected executions and task runs are reconciled.
Pause backfill workers and forward-fix the additive backfill resource, occurrence and event tables; retain generated execution lineage and immutable event evidence.
Pause new asynchronous task deferrals and forward-fix additive attempt evidence or resume-token state; retain task attempt history and reject unresolved callbacks until reconciled.
Stop recording new backup checkpoints and forward-fix the additive table; retain existing LSN and object-manifest evidence for restore qualification.
Keep the generated shard key and claim timestamp in place while old and new consumers overlap; forward-fix shard allocation without deleting committed queue rows.
Stop new reconciliation runs and forward-fix the additive run/finding ledgers; retain repair and quarantine evidence with its audit events.
Stop independent service-role deployments and forward-fix the additive registry; retain drain audit evidence and let compact deployments continue using PostgreSQL runtime truth.
Stop scheduled recovery exercises and forward-fix the additive evidence ledger or projection rebuild function; retain all checkpoint and exercise evidence.
Disable local browser login and forward-fix the additive credential/session tables; retain password hashes, revocation state and secret-free authentication audit evidence.

Keep task-attempt evidence authoritative, stop optional evidence exporters and forward-fix the additive projections or triggers; do not discard committed logs, metrics, outputs, artifact references or cursor history.
Disable taskCache on flows and forward-fix the additive cache tables; retain decision and purge evidence, while normal uncached task execution remains authoritative.
Pause trigger ingestion and forward-fix the additive runtime, occurrence and event ledgers; retain checkpoints, dead letters, replay lineage and execution links as operational evidence.
Pause deadline and check-action consumers and forward-fix the additive policy, definition, evaluation and action ledgers; retain all compliance evidence.
Keep process configuration at its last accepted snapshot, stop feature-flag administration and forward-fix the additive flag table; retain flag and configuration audit evidence.
Stop flow revision promotion and forward-fix the additive revision metadata and event ledger; retain immutable definitions, execution references and audit evidence.
Keep flow revision history enabled and forward-fix the event-to-flow retention constraint; preserve events until their owning flow is explicitly purged.
Pause conditional-flow dispatch and forward-fix the additive terminal result and control-evidence columns; retain task-run events and ordinary task-attempt evidence.
Pause lifecycle-hook dispatch and forward-fix the additive phase and execution-evidence columns; preserve primary execution events and all lifecycle task attempts.
Pause typed flow-output publication and forward-fix the additive outputs column; preserve execution inputs, task results and terminal event evidence.
Pause namespace workflow-metadata updates and forward-fix the additive metadata table, label columns and indexes; preserve immutable flow revisions and existing resource labels.
Pause namespace resource writes and runtime resolution, then forward-fix the additive file, key-value, secret-binding and permission records; retain immutable object versions and audit evidence.
Pause working-directory output collection and forward-fix the additive artifact path and lineage columns; retain object payloads and existing execution evidence.
Stop indexer-owned webhook delivery and forward-fix the additive realtime projection and subscription ledgers; retain cursor, delivery, retry and audit evidence.
Forward-fix the state-evidence capture functions; existing evidence remains valid and newly captured actor and causation fields are additive.
Pause custom dashboard writes and forward-fix the additive definition, ACL and event tables; built-in dashboards and all underlying execution projections remain available.
Stop optional search projection cycles and forward-fix or rebuild the disposable tenant-scoped documents and checkpoints; authoritative resources, events, logs and orchestration remain available.
Disable federated login and SCIM writes, preserve identity links and replay evidence, and forward-fix the additive federation tables before re-enabling providers.

Pause audit policy, export and compliance-package operations; preserve the existing audit ledger and additive hashes, holds, receipts and evidence records; then forward-fix integrity or policy behavior before resuming retention.

Pause plugin policy changes and new third-party execution starts; preserve immutable flow-revision pins, policy decisions, quarantines and audit evidence; then forward-fix the additive governance tables before resuming administration.
Pause asset declarations and plugin asset-event ingestion; preserve catalog identities, observations and lineage edges; then forward-fix the additive metadata before resuming catalog writes.
Pause app revision writes and new human-approval tasks; retain app revisions, participant actions and pending decisions; then forward-fix the additive ledgers and resume reconciliation.

Deactivate operational controls through the exempt administration API, preserve announcement, control, acknowledgement and event evidence, then forward-fix the additive tables and enforcement readers.
Disable namespace flow-test gates, preserve revision-pinned definitions and run evidence, then forward-fix the additive test and gate tables before resuming promotion enforcement.

Disable optional search projection cycles, keep orchestration on authoritative PostgreSQL state, preserve the v1 projection tables, and forward-fix or rebuild the disposable v2 generations, checkpoints, archives and rollups before re-enabling projected reads.

Disable optional OTLP export and continue core orchestration; preserve execution and task-run events with their additive trace carriers, then forward-fix propagation or exporter configuration before re-enabling external collection.
Disable scheduled lifecycle processing, preserve policy, preview, job, item and event evidence, and forward-fix the additive coordinator tables before resuming manual or scheduled purge batches.

Stop policy revision writes, disable the admission-policy hook while retaining immutable revisions, decisions and audit evidence, then forward-fix the additive policy tables before restoring enforcement.
Disable new model and MCP task dispatch, preserve connection revisions and invocation evidence, then forward-fix the additive primitive tables before restoring external calls.
Disable agent-definition writes and new capability-envelope resolution, preserve immutable revisions and pins, then forward-fix the additive resource tables before restoring resolution.
Disable new agent-session dispatch, preserve capability pins, checkpoints, event evidence and primitive invocations, then forward-fix the additive session journal before restoring dispatch.
Disable memory-enabled agent-session dispatch and memory API writes, preserve scoped content digests and provenance, then forward-fix the additive memory journal before restoring access.
Keep role liveness checks active, treat DEGRADED as not ready, preserve success and failure timestamps, and forward-fix registry health reporting before restoring aggregate readiness.
Stop canonical bundle writes and forward-fix readers; retain immutable bundles and their outbox evidence until an approved retention process removes them.
Stop new MCP and plugin tool dispatch, preserve provider invocation evidence and STARTED ambiguity records, then forward-fix the additive journal before restoring dispatch.
Stop continuation-enabled model dispatch, preserve encrypted continuation columns and invocation evidence, then restore the configured read keys and forward-fix before resuming continuation calls.
Stop promotion, rollback and kill-switch changes, preserve policy, evidence and release history, then forward-fix the additive release-gate tables before resuming release actions.
Stop new differential and shadow comparisons, preserve immutable frozen-input specs, independent runs and comparison events, then forward-fix the additive journal before resuming comparisons.
Stop writes using the expanded evidence kinds, preserve existing canonical evidence, and forward-fix readers or event producers before restoring those writes.
Stop accepting sensitive trigger input until the application encryption key is available; retain protected payloads and forward-fix readers before resuming.
Stop new agent-session launches and harness resume operations, preserve existing attempt journals, and forward-fix the additive harness provenance columns and service-session index before resuming.

Keep the session-specific grants and fleet indexes in place during compatibility rollout; forward-fix authorization or query behavior, and retain execution-permission fallback evidence until the compatibility period ends.

Stop session-policy writes and continue using the last accepted revision while forward-fixing policy validation or optimistic-concurrency conflicts; preserve immutable policy revisions and audit evidence.
Stop profile and session import admission and forward-fix the immutable import ledger; retain digest conflicts and target-tenant isolation evidence before resuming.
Stop new progress replay reads, retain the canonical agent session event journal, and forward-fix the progress index before resuming.
Stop new accounting checkpoints and IN_DOUBT finalization, preserve recorded accounting and terminal ambiguity evidence, and forward-fix invocation readers before resuming model dispatch.

Keep the nullable ceiling columns and explicit mode in place, stop provider-bounded policy writes, and forward-fix readers before resuming session-policy changes; existing BOUNDED rows retain their original finite values.

Keep the additive restricted-role grants in place while forward-fixing repository role selection; revoking them during a mixed-version rollout can break identity, audit and control-plane operations for non-superuser application logins.
Keep the additive binding UPDATE grant in place while forward-fixing authorization deletion; revoking it prevents the tenant-admin role from acquiring the row lock required for safe binding deletion.

Keep the additive restored-state read grants and security-definer projection rebuild in place while forward-fixing operations access; reverting either change breaks recovery preparation under the restricted admin role.

Keep projection rebuild execution restricted to amesh_tenant_admin while forward-fixing recovery operations; restoring PUBLIC or runtime execution would expose owner-privileged materialized-view refresh.
Keep the additive progress cursor, source and closed-segment state while forward-fixing writers; dropping it restores quadratic journal replay and loses the bounded append contract.
